description:
Atmosphere of the Les Halles food market in Tours (France). It's midday, not too busy. We walk through the aisles of this beautiful roofed place, among stalls selling fruit, vegetables, meat, fish and cheese. We overhear a few conversations between sellers and shoppers. Some meat chopping at 0.20 and 1.45, some coughing at 1.26. At 2.15 we go outside, where there's an open air market. Not too much hustle, though.

Recorded with Sony PCM-D50's stereo mics with a wind muff on.
name: Les Halles market in the French town of Tours
